name: rag_orchestrator
description: RAG Orchestrator with Access Control - Orchestrates RAG pipeline with Qdrant and LLM integration, includes per-user/client configuration and ACL
author: UBP Team

operations.name: initialize
operations.description: Initialize RAG Orchestrator with dependencies injection

operations.name: create_knowledge_base
operations.description: Create a new knowledge base (Qdrant collection) - ADMIN ONLY

operations.name: ingest_document
operations.description: Ingest a text document into a knowledge base - ADMIN ONLY

parameters.tags: array[string] (optional, document tags for search filtering. Auto-extracted from filename if omitted)

operations.name: ingest_document_authorized
operations.description: Ingest a text document with ACL-based authorization - Requires write permission on collection. Fixes GAP-INGEST-002.

parameters.tags: array[string] (optional, document tags for search filtering. Auto-extracted from filename if omitted)

operations.name: ingest_file
operations.description: Ingest a file (TXT, MD, PDF, JSON) into a knowledge base with server-side text extraction - ADMIN ONLY

parameters.file_content: string (required, file content - base64 for PDF, plaintext for others)
parameters.tags: array[string] (optional, document tags for search filtering. Auto-extracted from filename if omitted)

operations.name: set_permission
operations.description: Set access permission for an entity (user or client) on a collection - ADMIN ONLY

operations.name: get_permissions
operations.description: Get all permissions for a collection or entity - Admins see all, users see only their own

parameters.entity_id: string (optional, filter by entity - non-admins are restricted to own user)

operations.name: set_rag_config
operations.description: Set RAG configuration for an entity (user, client, or default) - ADMIN ONLY

parameters.entity_id: string (optional, user_id or client_id, null for default)
parameters.config_json: object (required, RAG configuration with model, temperature, top_k, system_prompt)

operations.name: get_rag_config
operations.description: Get RAG configuration for an entity (with fallback to default) - Users get own config, admins get any

parameters.entity_id: string (optional, defaults to ctx.user.user_id for non-admins)

operations.name: rag_chat
operations.description: The magic function - Execute RAG pipeline with ACL checks. User identity from security context (ctx), NOT from parameters.

parameters.collections: array of strings (optional, specific collections to query)
parameters.override_config: object (optional, override RAG config for this request)
parameters.conversation_id: string (optional, existing conversation ID to continue)

returns.sources: array of source documents with metadata
returns.debug: object (optional debug info with retrieved chunks)

operations.notes: User identity (user_id, client_id) is automatically extracted from the security context (ctx). If conversation_id is not provided, a new conversation is created. Messages are automatically persisted.

operations.name: get_user_collections
operations.description: Get collections accessible by current user (alias for list_knowledge_bases filtering). Fixes GAP-001.

operations.name: set_pipeline_permission
operations.description: Set access permission for pipeline - ADMIN ONLY

parameters.entity_id: string (user_id or client_id, null for default)
parameters.pipeline_name: string (pipeline template name or '*' for all)

operations.name: get_user_pipelines
operations.description: Get pipelines accessible by current user based on ACL

operations.name: list_knowledge_bases
operations.description: List all knowledge bases (collections) accessible by user. User identity from security context.

returns.collections: array of collection objects with metadata

operations.notes: User identity is automatically extracted from the security context. Admins see all collections, users see only accessible ones.

operations.name: delete_personal_document
operations.description: Delete a document from the user's Personal KB

document_id.description: ID of the document to delete

operations.name: delete_knowledge_base
operations.description: Delete a knowledge base completely (Qdrant collection + ACL bindings + client assignments) - ADMIN ONLY

parameters.name: string (preferred, collection name to delete)
parameters.force: boolean (optional, default false - skip rebuild safety check)

operations.notes: Either 'name' or 'collection_id' must be provided. Deletion is blocked for populated KBs with matching dimensions unless force=true. The 'collection_id' parameter is deprecated and will be removed in v2.0.

operations.name: health_check
operations.description: Perform health check on module and dependencies

returns.dependencies: object (status of rag_qdrant and inference modules)

operations.name: get_stats
operations.description: Get module statistics and metrics - ADMIN ONLY

operations.name: reload_router_config
operations.description: Hot-reload router configuration (weights + config) without restart - ADMIN ONLY
operations.notes: Reloads router_weights.yaml and rebuilds RouterConfig from UBP_ROUTER__* environment variables. Changes take effect immediately for subsequent queries.

operations.name: list_conversations
operations.description: List all conversations for the current user. User identity from security context.

parameters.limit: integer (optional, max conversations to return, default 50)

returns.conversations: array of conversation objects with id, title, created_at, updated_at, message_count

operations.notes: User identity is automatically extracted from the security context. Each user sees only their own conversations.

operations.name: get_conversation
operations.description: Get a specific conversation with all messages. User identity from security context.

returns.conversation: object with id, title, created_at, updated_at, messages array, message_count

operations.notes: Users can only access their own conversations.

operations.name: delete_conversation
operations.description: Delete a conversation. User identity from security context.
operations.notes: Users can only delete their own conversations.

operations.name: create_conversation
operations.description: Create a new conversation explicitly. Usually auto-created on first message.

operations.name: update_conversation_title
operations.description: Update the title of a conversation.

operations.name: ask_architect
operations.description: Ask the System Architect Agent a question. Uses RAG on official UBP documentation (KB: ubp_system_docs) with Grok-4 2M context. Returns structured responses with [ANALISI], [RIFERIMENTI], [DIRETTIVA] format.

parameters.max_tokens: number (optional, override response max tokens, default 8000)
parameters.top_k: number (optional, override retrieval top_k, default from config)
parameters.hyde_enabled: boolean (optional, enable HyDE for improved retrieval, default false)
parameters.investigative_enabled: boolean (optional, enable Investigative Query Decomposition v2.2.2, default false)
parameters.reranking_enabled: boolean (optional, enable cross-encoder reranking, default true)
parameters.adaptive_budget_enabled: boolean (optional, enable adaptive budget manager v3.5.1, default from UBP_ADAPTIVE_BUDGET__ENABLED)

returns.config_used: object (top_k, reranking_enabled, relevance_threshold, hyde_enabled, investigative_enabled, max_tokens)
returns.debug: object (optional, chunks_retrieved, hyde_document if HyDE enabled)

operations.notes: Requires UBP_ARCHITECT__ENABLED=true. KB 'ubp_system_docs' must be populated with official documentation. See MANUAL_14_ARCHITECT_AGENT.md. v2.2.2: Added investigative_enabled, reranking_enabled parameters with client override support.

operations.name: start_report
operations.description: v2.3: Start an interactive report generation session. Detects template from query and proposes a structured plan.

parameters.collections: array of strings (optional, collections to use for RAG)

operations.notes: Part of Interactive Analyst v2.3. User can approve, modify, or cancel the proposed plan. Session state is persisted in Redis.

operations.name: get_report_session
operations.description: v2.3: Get current state of a report session

operations.name: approve_structure
operations.description: v2.6: Approve report structure and transition to enrichment configuration phase

returns.presets_available: array (available preset names: fast, standard, quality, custom)
returns.enrichment_options: object (available enrichment options with labels and descriptions)

operations.notes: v2.6: Transitions from awaiting_approval to awaiting_enrichment_config. Returns sections with default enrichment presets based on source_preference for UI rendering.

operations.name: configure_enrichment
operations.description: v2.6: Configure enrichment settings for each section and start research

parameters.section_configs: array (required, enrichment config per section: [{index, rerank_enabled, query_expansion_enabled, hyde_enabled, investigative_enabled, metadata_injection_enabled, debug_enabled}])
parameters.global_debug: boolean (optional, enable debug for all sections)

returns.debug_enabled: boolean (true if any debug is enabled)
returns.debug_events_key: string (Redis key for debug events polling)

operations.notes: v2.6: Applies user-configured enrichment to each section and starts swarm execution. If debug is enabled, events are streamed to Redis for frontend polling.

operations.name: get_debug_events
operations.description: v2.6: Get debug events for real-time worker execution visualization

parameters.from_index: integer (optional, start index for pagination, default 0)

returns.events: array (debug events with phase, settings, input/output data, metrics)
returns.is_complete: boolean (true if research phase is complete)

operations.notes: v2.6: Poll this endpoint for real-time debug events. Events include worker init, enrichment steps, retrieval, reranking, and completion. Use from_index for efficient polling.

operations.name: list_report_templates
operations.description: v2.3: List available report templates

returns.templates: array of template objects with id, name, description, category, sections_count

operations.name: get_report_draft
operations.description: v2.4: Get the generated report draft after swarm execution completes

returns.sections: array (section drafts with content and metrics)

operations.notes: Returns not_ready if swarm execution is still in progress. Poll get_swarm_status for progress updates.

operations.name: get_swarm_status
operations.description: v2.4: Get the current swarm execution status for a report session
operations.notes: Use this to poll for swarm completion. When status=completed, call get_report_draft to retrieve the full report.

operations.name: start_batch_ingest
operations.description: Start a server-side batch ingestion job. All files are uploaded in a single POST and processed sequentially in a background task. The browser can close/reload without interrupting ingestion.

parameters.tags: array[string] (optional, document tags for search filtering. Auto-extracted from filename if omitted)

operations.notes: Files are stored in Redis and processed server-side. Poll get_batch_ingest_status for progress. Max recommended batch: ~100 files.

operations.name: get_batch_ingest_status
operations.description: Get batch ingestion job status with per-file details. Supports reconnect by collection_id (finds active job for current user).

parameters.collection_id: string (optional, find active job for reconnect)

operations.notes: Use collection_id for browser reconnect after reload. Poll every 2 seconds during active ingestion.

operations.name: cancel_batch_ingest
operations.description: Cancel an active batch ingestion job. The background task stops before the next file.

operations.name: retrieve_with_acl
operations.description: Retrieve documents from knowledge base with ACL enforcement. Same ACL check as rag_chat but retrieval only — no LLM generation. Returns chunks ordered by semantic relevance, filtered by user's authorized collections.

collections.description: Target collection names (filtered by ACL). If empty, searches all authorized collections.

returns.chunks: array of documents with content, score, metadata, collection
returns.collections_used: array of collection names that had results

operations.notes: Requires security context (ctx). ACL enforced via get_user_collections(). Accepts parameter aliases: query (for query_text), collection/collection_name (single collection).

operations.name: retrieve_enriched
operations.description: Retrieve documents with UBP enrichment pipeline (rerank, dedup, fusion). Returns enriched chunks without LLM generation.

collections.description: Target collection names (ACL-filtered). If empty, searches all authorized collections.

top_k.description: Number of enriched results to return (1-20)

returns.chunks: array of enriched documents with content, score, metadata, collection
returns.collections_used: array of collection names that had results
returns.enrichment_applied: array of enrichment step names executed
returns.warnings: array of warning strings (empty if no issues)

operations.notes: Uses identical 4-layer config resolution as rag_chat (System → Client → Collection → User). Enrichment flags determined by canonical UBP config, not exposed as parameters in v1. Accepts parameter aliases: query (for query_text), collection/collection_name (single collection).

dependencies.redis_keys_note: Keys are prefixed by RedisKeyManager based on environment. Test: ubp:test:{suite}:rag:*, Dev: ubp:dev:rag:*, Prod: ubp:rag:*. See NAMING_POLICY.md Section 7.
